working_definition: Anterodorsal-lineage antennal-lobe olfactory projection neurons within Davie et al. 2018 res-2.0 cluster 27, resolved to the adPN developmental lineage (derived from the anterodorsal neuroblast, mostly uniglomerular, projecting via the iACT/mALT to mushroom body calyx and lateral horn) but not further resolved into any Li et al. (2017) marker subgroup (C15+/kn+/C15+kn+). Cholinergic (ChAT/VAChT).
searches_performed: adult antennal lobe projection neuron adPN

best_match.fbbt_term: adult antennal lobe projection neuron adPN
best_match.fbbt_definition: An adult antennal lobe projection neuron that is derived from neuroblast ALad1 (FBbt:00067346). All of these neurons have axons that fasciculate with the medial antennal lobe tract (mALT) and innervate the lateral horn.

justification: FBbt:00007438 is defined exactly at the lineage level this cluster occupies: all antennal lobe PNs derived from the anterodorsal neuroblast (ALad1), matching the report's description of adPN origin, uniglomerular dendrites, mALT/iACT axon tract, and lateral horn/calyx targets. The cluster carries no finer marker information (C15/kn), so no more specific FBbt term (e.g. individual glomerular adPN types, or the C15+/kn+ subgroup terms, which do not exist in FBbt) can be justified. Same biology as the FBbt lineage class, different naming convention (driver/lineage label vs formal FBbt term) - genuine exact match, not a forced generalisation.

other_candidates.fbbt_term: adult uniglomerular antennal lobe projection neuron adPN
other_candidates.fbbt_definition: An adult uniglomerular antennal lobe projection neuron that is derived from the neuroblast ALad1 (FBbt:00067346). All of these neurons have axons that fasciculate with the medial antennal lobe tract (mALT) and except for V adPN neurons, innervate the mushroom body calyx (via a collateral) and the lateral horn.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Restricted to uniglomerular adPNs only; report notes adPNs are 'mostly' but not exclusively uniglomerular, and this label carries no data narrowing it to that subset specifically. FBbt:00007438 is the safer, unrestricted lineage-level match.

recommendation: Accept as exact match at the adPN lineage level - this is the correct resolution for a lineage-only label.
